title: Parcel 12
previewText: On Parcel 12, where a supplemental public access area adjoining an upland connection or street is provided, such supplemental public access area shall be permitted to be provided with a maximum width to depth ratio of 3:1, and the longest side shall be permitted to adjoin the street.
